### Super Omikuji (Big Bang Fortune)

> Trigger words: `超` / `超おみくじ` / `ビッグバン` / `BigBang`

- A joke omikuji that literally goes "orders of magnitude" beyond, enjoyed purely for the vibes of its omikuji-ish strings of text.
- The rarity of Great Blessing (大吉) is "9", and that of Great Curse (大凶) is "1".
- The ideas behind this omikuji draw on the following:
	- The Shuryogon Sutra (the names of large numbers)
	- The Lotus Sutra, "Chapter on the Emergence of the Treasure Tower" (omikuji sticks coming out of the earth)
	- Mogitate Tingle no Barairo Rupee Land
	- "I want 5,000 trillion yen!" (5,000 trillion)
	- Gundam Try Age (9999 muryotaisu)
